releaseNotes: Split the heavy CI lane across two runners with a new --shard i/n on the audit runner, so the multi-minute serial suites stop running one after another in a single two-vCPU job.

Partition serial steps round-robin in audit-plan.ts and prove in audit.fixtures.ts that every serial step runs in exactly one shard at every width, so a suite added later cannot land in no shard at all.
